desc:
👮 RUN A PRISON
Your prison. Your rules. Build a towering prison complex, command your security force, and hunt down rare criminals. Keeping them locked up is where the real challenge begins!

🏗️ BUILD UP AND OUT
Stack buildings, upgrade your facilities, and turn a small prison into a profitable empire.

🚔 COMMAND YOUR FORCE
Train security and expand your team to capture dangerous criminals. Bigger targets need stronger forces!

💰 BIGGER RISKS, BIGGER REWARDS
Rare prisoners bring in more profit—but they can ESCAPE! Keep your security ready to protect your earnings.

🔑 YOU’RE THE WARDEN
Build for profit, strengthen your security, or chase the rarest criminals. Every decision shapes your prison.

Can you build a prison that holds them all?

👍 Enjoying your time as warden? Give the game a thumbs up!
🐞 Currently in Beta. Report bugs in our Roblox Community!
